title: Introduction to the Salafi Dawah
description: Understanding the Salafi methodology and the call to pure monotheism (Tawheed) upon the understanding of the Salaf (righteous predecessors). This course covers the defining features of the Salafi Da'wah, the importance of returning to the Qur'an and Sunnah, and the methodology of Ahlus-Sunnah wal-Jama'ah.
short_description: Learn the fundamentals of the Salafi methodology and call to pure Islam

modules.title: Foundations of the Salafi Dawah
modules.description: Understanding the core principles and methodology of the Salafi call to Islam.

lessons.title: What is the Salafi Dawah?
lessons.content: An introduction to the Salafi Da'wah (الدعوة السلفية) - understanding what it means to follow the way of the Salaf (السلف) and the defining features of this methodology.

lessons.title: The Importance of Tawheed
lessons.content: Understanding the centrality of Tawheed (توحيد) - pure monotheism - in the Salafi methodology and why it is the foundation of all rectification.

lessons.title: Following the Qur'an and Sunnah
lessons.content: The methodology of understanding Islam through the Book of Allah and the Sunnah of His Messenger (صلّ الله عليه وسلّم) as understood by the Salaf.

lessons.title: The Companions and Their Way
lessons.content: The virtue of the Sahaba (الصحابة) and why their understanding serves as the criterion for correct Islamic creed and methodology.

modules.title: Distinguishing Features of the Salafi Dawah
modules.description: Key characteristics that distinguish the Salafi methodology from other calls.

lessons.title: Calling to Worship Allah Alone
lessons.content: The first and most important distinguishing sign of the Salafi: calling to the worship of Allah alone without associating partners (شرك) with Him.

lessons.title: Purification of the Religion
lessons.content: Understanding the importance of Tazkiyah (تزكية) - purification of the soul and the religion from innovations (بدعة) and polytheistic practices.

lessons.title: Gentleness in Da'wah
lessons.content: The importance of spreading the Da'wah with Hikmah (حكمة) - wisdom - and beautiful preaching, following the example of the Messenger (صلّ الله عليه وسلّم).

lessons.title: The Straight Path of Allah
lessons.content: Understanding Sirat al-Mustaqim (الصراط المستقيم) - the straight path - and how to remain upon it in times of trial and tribulation.
